news.title: Install CCTV cameras at critical points, Christian bodies urge Bengal churches
news.description: Bengal Christian groups urge churches to install CCTV amid alleged attacks; ask state action, cite 50 incidents, and urge BJP to stop conversion accusations.

news.title: CM presents Rs 24,150 crore supplementary budget
news.description: Odisha CM Mohan Charan Majhi tables Rs 24,150-crore 2026-27 supplementary budget, prioritising food subsidy, free education, women’s aid, farmers’ subsidy.

news.title: Bengaluru-based Shikshagraha’s #TumBolo 1 million voices on education debate
news.description: Shikshagraha launches #TumBolo campaign to gather 1 million multilingual responses on skills youth need, via website, IVR and AI bot, supporting NEP 2020 goals.

news.title: Madras HC directs TN govt not to open any new Tasmac shops
news.description: Madras High Court directs Tamil Nadu govt not to open new Tasmac shops, citing public interest, after PIL opposing a proposed outlet in Trichy village.

news.title: Census to begin in Bihar on Jan 25: Minister
news.description: Bihar to begin 2027 Census door-to-door enumeration Jan 25–Feb 28, with self-enumeration available online Jan 10–24, says minister Dilip Kumar Jaiswal.

news.title: Lynched constable’s family wants probe handed over to CBI
news.description: Family of lynched railway constable Soumya Ranjan Swain in Bhubaneswar demands CBI probe, alleging conspiracy; crime branch says investigation is on track.

news.title: Bengal brings back central agencies for state projects
news.description: Bengal govt restores CPWD, NBCC, RITES and EIL eligibility to execute state infrastructure projects, mandating e-tendering/GeM use and CVC guidelines.

news.title: Vigilance seizes illegal collections from temple barbers
news.description: DVAC raid at Irukkankudi Mariamman temple tonsure hall seizes ₹59,600 from barbers allegedly collecting fees despite free tonsure scheme; ₹60 crore works probed.

news.title: Uttam Criticises BRS Over Water Crisis, Says State Has Already Flagged AP’s 1.8 TMC Drinking Water Scheme
news.description: Telangana irrigation minister Uttam Kumar Reddy slams BRS on water crisis, objects to AP plan to draw 1.8 TMC from Nagarjuna Sagar; seeks 555 TMC share.

news.title: Gold, silver prices in Indian markets crash to nearly a year’s low
news.description: Rates drop in line with global trend, where the precious metals have dropped to a 14-month low on strengthening dollar, hopes of US Fed rate hike
